about_the_game:
Story.

A noble thief who waged war with the chivalric order... After his defeat, he became reviled as the Great Pirate of Evil. His body was lost to the dark depths of the ocean.

~20 Years Pass~

Looking up at a small sailing ship there stands a young, naive girl full of hopes and dreams. Her name is Luvina. To reclaim her lost father's tarnished honor, she sets off on a voyage in search of the hidden treasure known as the Artemis Pearl.

Characters.

Luvina

The daughter of the Great Pirate. After 10 years of saving money from menial jobs, she earned enough for the small sailing ship she always wanted.

To restore her father's honor, she goes in search of the Artemis Pearl,

a hidden treasure he once possessed.

She is very guarded.

Styria

A captain of the chivalric order, who seek to suppress pirates. Though a noble knight, she is a realist who will do

whatever it takes to achieve her goals.

Monkey

A primitive man from Sumwhere Island, where Luvina stops on her journey. He cannot speak human language,

but can communicate through physical gestures.

Has endless sexual stamina.

Goinvald

A loyal subordinate of Luvina's late father.

The only survivor of the war of ten years earlier, he has been protecting Luvina in secret.

Luvina consistently gets his name wrong, and calls him "Goinbald".

Has a wife and children
